$comment: Committed licence registry for non-npm ecosystems (cargo, maven), recorded from each package's public registry with per-entry provenance. Cargo.lock and build.gradle.kts carry no licence metadata, so the SBOM generator reads THIS file — deterministic, no network at generation time. A component absent from this registry is emitted with its licence unresolved and scripts/check-licence-policy.mjs routes it to REVIEW: a named unknown, never a silent omission. Re-record by re-running the recorder when a lockfile changes.
